name: Sunset
purpose: Stops emailing people who no longer open.
trigger: someone enters the unengaged group: no opens or clicks in 120 days

steps.name: Still want these?
steps.job: One clear button to stay subscribed.
steps.subject: Still want to hear from us?

steps.yes: Stops. They stay on the list.

steps.text: Marketing emails to them are switched off.

needs: A group built from opens and clicks.
why: Inbox providers judge a sender by how many people engage.
Klaviyo bills by active profiles, so a clean list also costs less.
